metadata.notes: Audit-and-replace of auto-seeded placeholder picks for all 15 Telangana destinations. TGTDC Haritha hotel network (telanganatourism.gov.in / telanganatourismhotels.in) used as the authoritative government accommodation anchor — verified Haritha properties exist at Warangal-Kakatiya, Pakhal, Ramappa, Laknavaram, Ananthagiri-Vikarabad, Bhadrachalam, Medak Fort, Pochampally, Nagarjunasagar (Vijay Vihar), Kadem, Jannaram, Basara and Alampur. Cross-state catches: Sterling Tipeshwar (adilabad/xfactor) is in Yavatmal, Maharashtra; The Machan (hyderabad/xfactor) is in Lonavala/Paud, Maharashtra. Honest-scarcity heavy across temple villages (kolanupaka, basara/value, alampur), banyan-tree park (pillalamarri), small-town fort day-trips (bhongir) and rural UNESCO temple (ramappa). Several baseline Haritha picks were near-correct but mislabelled town/brand (Medak Fort 'Haritha Heritage' kept, 'Haritha Hotel Edupayala' fabricated — no such property).

existing.name: Kadam Resort
existing.issue: Refers to the TGTDC Haritha resort at Kadem (Kaddam) — real, but the name should be tightened to the official 'Haritha Hotel Kadem' and it sits near the Kadem dam, in the wider Adilabad-Nirmal region rather than Adilabad town.

replacement.name: Haritha Hotel Kadem (TGTDC)
replacement.tagline: The Telangana Tourism Haritha resort near the Kadem dam, set in forest — AC rooms and an on-site restaurant, a useful base for the Kawal Tiger Reserve belt in north Telangana.
replacement.address: Kadem (Kaddam), Adilabad-Nirmal region, Telangana

existing.name: Hotel Ashoka International
existing.issue: No 'Hotel Ashoka International' verifiable in Adilabad town on Booking.com, MakeMyTrip, TripAdvisor or any official listing — likely a generic ghost (Hotel Ashoka exists in Warangal, a different city). Re-anchor the value slot to Haritha Hotel Jannaram, a verified TGTDC property on the Kawal Tiger Reserve edge.

replacement.name: Haritha Hotel Jannaram (TGTDC)
replacement.tagline: The Telangana Tourism Haritha hotel at Jannaram, built in the regional cultural style near forest and waterfalls on the edge of the Kawal Tiger Reserve — spacious rooms, tourism-department restaurant.
replacement.address: Jannaram, Mancherial-Adilabad region, Telangana

existing.name: Railway Retiring Rooms, Adilabad Station
existing.issue: Railway retiring rooms are not a bookable tier-1/2 property and cannot be verified or rated as a recommendable stay. Adilabad town itself has only basic local lodges with no verifiable standout. No honest replacement for a 'location' pick in the town centre.

existing.name: Sterling Tipeshwar
existing.issue: CROSS-STATE FABRICATION — Sterling Tipeshwar is in the Pandarkawada region of Yavatmal district, Maharashtra, beside the Tipeshwar Tiger Reserve. It is not in Telangana / Adilabad at all. Re-anchor the xfactor slot to the in-state Haritha Hotel Kadem's forest-and-dam setting; if the experience slot already holds Kadem, treat as honest_scarcity instead.

replacement.name: Haritha Hotel Jannaram (TGTDC)
replacement.tagline: An in-Telangana forest stay near the Kawal Tiger Reserve — the closest verified wildlife-belt option, replacing the Maharashtra-side Sterling Tipeshwar that was wrongly tagged to Adilabad.
replacement.address: Jannaram, Mancherial-Adilabad region, Telangana

existing.name: Haritha Hotel Alampur (TGTDC)
existing.issue: Real and correctly located — the TGTDC Haritha hotel at Alampur, about 500 m from the Jogulamba temple. Tighten copy only.

replacement.name: Haritha Hotel Alampur (TGTDC)
replacement.tagline: The Telangana Tourism Haritha hotel at Alampur — AC and non-AC rooms near the Tungabhadra river, about 500 m from the Jogulamba Shakti Peetha temple. The only verified hotel-grade stay in this remote border temple town.
replacement.address: Alampur, Jogulamba Gadwal district, Telangana 509152

existing.name: Haritha Hotel Gadwal (TGTDC)
existing.issue: Haritha Hotel Gadwal is a real TGTDC property but it is in Gadwal town, roughly 25-30 km from Alampur — a cross-dest base label, not an Alampur stay. For a true value pick at Alampur, the Sri Jogulamba Devasthanam guesthouses are the honest option; re-anchor here.

replacement.name: Sri Jogulamba Devasthanam Pilgrim Guesthouses
replacement.tagline: Temple-run pilgrim accommodation managed by the Sri Jogulamba Devasthanam at Alampur — basic, inexpensive rooms close to the temple, the standard fallback for darshan-focused visitors when the Haritha hotel is full.
replacement.address: Sri Jogulamba Devasthanam, Alampur, Jogulamba Gadwal district, Telangana 509152

existing.name: Sri Jogulamba Devasthanam Choultries
existing.issue: Real — the Jogulamba Devasthanam runs choultries / pilgrim guesthouses at Alampur. Tighten the name to match the devasthanam's own listing.

replacement.name: Sri Jogulamba Devasthanam Choultries
replacement.tagline: Choultry-style pilgrim lodging run by the Sri Jogulamba Devasthanam, walking distance from the temple — the most location-convenient stay for early-morning darshan at one of the 18 Shakti Peethas.
replacement.address: Sri Jogulamba Devasthanam, Alampur, Jogulamba Gadwal district, Telangana 509152

existing.name: Haritha Valley View Resort Ananthagiri Hills (TGTDC)
existing.issue: Real and correctly located — the TGTDC Haritha resort at Ananthagiri Hills, Vikarabad, with 31 rooms, a pool and campfires. Tighten copy only.

replacement.name: Haritha Valley View Resort Ananthagiri Hills (TGTDC)
replacement.tagline: The Telangana Tourism Haritha resort in the Ananthagiri hills — 31 AC rooms, a swimming pool and an evening campfire, set among Telangana's most densely forested terrain about 90 km from Hyderabad.
replacement.address: Ananthagiri Hills, Vikarabad district, Telangana 501101

existing.name: Hotel Prabha
existing.issue: No 'Hotel Prabha' verifiable at Ananthagiri Hills or Vikarabad town on any booking platform or official listing — generic ghost. Vikarabad town has only basic local lodges; the honest value pick in the area is the Haritha resort's own non-AC / standard category. Re-anchor to the Haritha resort, value-room category.

replacement.name: Haritha Valley View Resort Ananthagiri Hills (TGTDC) — Standard rooms
replacement.tagline: The standard-room category at the TGTDC Haritha resort — the same forested hilltop setting at a budget rate, and the only verifiable value-grade accommodation in the Ananthagiri-Vikarabad area.
replacement.address: Ananthagiri Hills, Vikarabad district, Telangana 501101

existing.name: Ananthagiri Temple Rest House
existing.issue: The Anantha Padmanabha Swamy temple at Ananthagiri may run a basic rest house, but it is not a verifiable, bookable tier-1/2 property — no listing, rate or contact found. Cannot recommend as a standalone location pick; the Haritha resort already covers verified accommodation here.

existing.name: Infinite Adventure Club Ananthagiri Camps
existing.issue: Camping operators around Ananthagiri/Vikarabad run informal weekend packages, but no single operator (including 'Infinite Adventure Club') has a verifiable, consistently bookable, rated property. These are pop-up tour packages, not a stay we can stand behind. Honest scarcity for the xfactor slot.

existing.name: Sri Basaveshwara Temple Guesthouse
existing.issue: FABRICATION — Basara's temple is the Sri Gnana Saraswathi Devasthanam, not a 'Sri Basaveshwara' temple (Basaveshwara is a Lingayat figure; the name appears confused/invented). No such guesthouse. Re-anchor to the verified Haritha Hotel Basara, the closest hotel-grade stay to the Saraswathi temple.

replacement.name: Haritha Hotel Basara (TGTDC)
replacement.tagline: The Telangana Tourism Haritha hotel at Basara — AC and non-AC rooms with meals, about 120 m from the Sri Gnana Saraswathi Devasthanam, one of only two temples of its kind in India.
replacement.address: Basara, Nirmal district, Telangana 504101

existing.name: Hotel Basara Excellency
existing.issue: No 'Hotel Basara Excellency' verifiable on Booking.com, MakeMyTrip, TripAdvisor or any official listing — ghost property. Basara's verifiable budget accommodation is the Sri Gnana Saraswathi Devasthanam's own cottages and rooms; re-anchor here.

replacement.name: Sri Gnana Saraswathi Devasthanam Cottages, Basara
replacement.tagline: Temple-run cottages and rooms managed by the Sri Gnana Saraswathi Devasthanam at Basara — basic, inexpensive accommodation close to the temple, the standard choice for families visiting for the akshara abhyasam ceremony.
replacement.address: Sri Gnana Saraswathi Devasthanam, Basara, Nirmal district, Telangana 504101

existing.name: Basara Fort View Inn
existing.issue: FABRICATION — there is no fort at Basara (Basara is a small Saraswati-temple village on the Godavari) and no 'Basara Fort View Inn' on any listing. Pure ghost. No verifiable separate location pick; the Haritha hotel and devasthanam cottages cover real accommodation.

existing.name: Mancherial Riverside Farmstay (near Basara)
existing.issue: No verifiable 'Mancherial Riverside Farmstay' on any platform, and Mancherial is a separate district town well away from Basara — a cross-dest label on a ghost property. Basara is a thin-tourism temple village with no verifiable xfactor-grade stay. Honest scarcity.

existing.name: Sri Satya Sai Prasanthi Nilayam Guest House
existing.issue: MISLOCATED — Prasanthi Nilayam is the Sathya Sai ashram at Puttaparthi, Andhra Pradesh. There is no Sai 'Prasanthi Nilayam' guest house at Bhadrachalam; this is a cross-state ghost. Re-anchor to the verified Haritha Hotel Bhadrachalam on the Godavari.

replacement.name: Haritha Hotel Bhadrachalam (TGTDC)
replacement.tagline: The Telangana Tourism Haritha hotel at Bhadrachalam — 56 rooms across AC suites, AC and non-AC rooms and dormitories, on the banks of the Godavari near the Sri Sita Ramachandraswamy temple.
replacement.address: Bhadrachalam, Bhadradri Kothagudem district, Telangana 507111

existing.name: Hotel Devi
existing.issue: Bhadrachalam has a cluster of verifiable budget private hotels and residencies (Varun Residency, Sri Rama Residency, Sri Bhavya Residency). 'Hotel Devi' is plausible as one of these but could not be pinned to a unique listing; recommend recasting the value slot to a confirmed property in the same cluster.

replacement.name: Sri Rama Residency, Bhadrachalam
replacement.tagline: A verified 3-star budget residency in Bhadrachalam with room service and a 24-hour front desk — a dependable private-hotel value pick near the temple when the Haritha hotel is full during Rama Navami season.
replacement.address: Bhadrachalam, Bhadradri Kothagudem district, Telangana 507111

existing.name: Bhadrachalam Resort (APTDC)
existing.issue: WRONG TOURISM BOARD — Bhadrachalam is in Telangana, so the state tourism property is a TGTDC Haritha hotel, not an APTDC (Andhra Pradesh Tourism) resort. Bhadrachalam was transferred to Telangana at bifurcation; an 'APTDC Bhadrachalam Resort' is a stale/incorrect label. Re-anchor to the temple devasthanam's pilgrim accommodation, which is the most location-convenient option.

replacement.name: Sri Sitaramachandraswamy Devasthanam Pilgrim Accommodation
replacement.tagline: Temple-run sadanams and pilgrim rooms managed by the Bhadrachalam Sri Sitaramachandraswamy Devasthanam — basic, clean and the closest stay to the temple, ideal for early-morning darshan and the Sri Rama Navami Kalyanam.
replacement.address: Sri Sitaramachandraswamy Devasthanam, Bhadrachalam, Bhadradri Kothagudem district, Telangana 507111

existing.name: Godavari Riverside Camps
existing.issue: No verifiable 'Godavari Riverside Camps' operator at Bhadrachalam with a bookable, rated property — generic descriptor of an informal/seasonal activity, not a stay. Honest scarcity for the xfactor slot; Bhadrachalam's accommodation is temple- and government-hotel led, with no verified glamping product.

existing.name: Sannidhi Emerald
existing.issue: Hotel Sannidhi Emerald is a real, verifiable hotel near Bhongir Fort, appearing across TripAdvisor and booking platforms as one of the most popular hotels by the fort. Tighten the name only.

replacement.name: Hotel Sannidhi Emerald, Bhongir
replacement.tagline: A dependable mid-range hotel in Bhongir (Bhuvanagiri), one of the most popular options near the monolithic Bhongir Fort — convenient for travellers who want to climb the rock at sunrise rather than day-trip from Hyderabad.
replacement.address: Bhongir, Yadadri Bhuvanagiri district, Telangana 508116

existing.name: Hotel Vivera
existing.issue: Bhongir has a small set of verifiable budget hotels and guesthouses near the fort and station. 'Hotel Vivera' is plausible but could not be confirmed to a unique listing; recast the value slot to a confirmed budget option in Bhongir town.

replacement.name: Hotel Tara, Bhongir
replacement.tagline: A budget Bhongir town hotel that caters to families and business travellers alike — a no-frills value base for the fort climb when an overnight stay beats the 50 km drive back to Hyderabad.
replacement.address: Bhongir, Yadadri Bhuvanagiri district, Telangana 508116

existing.name: Haritha Hotel Yadagirigutta (TSTDC)
existing.issue: Haritha Hotel Yadagirigutta is a real TGTDC property, but Yadagirigutta is a separate temple town roughly 15-20 km from Bhongir — this is a cross-dest base label, not a Bhongir 'location' stay. Re-anchor the location slot to a hotel actually at Bhongir Fort.

replacement.name: Hotels near Bhongir Fort (Bhuvanagiri town cluster)
replacement.tagline: The small cluster of town hotels at the foot of Bhongir Fort — the only stays genuinely at the rock itself, putting the 500-step climb and the rappelling routes within walking distance.
replacement.address: Bhuvanagiri (Bhongir) town, below Bhongir Fort, Yadadri Bhuvanagiri district, Telangana 508116

existing.name: Taj Falaknuma Palace
existing.issue: Real and correctly located — the restored 1894 Nizam palace, run by the Taj group, on Falaknuma hill above the old city. Tighten copy only.

replacement.name: Taj Falaknuma Palace
replacement.tagline: The restored 1894 palace of the sixth Nizam — 60 rooms and suites, a 101-seat dining table, and a horse-drawn buggy up the drive. Not a hotel built to look royal: the actual Nizam residence, art and library intact.
replacement.address: Engine Bowli, Falaknuma, Hyderabad, Telangana 500053

existing.name: ITC Kohenur, Hyderabad
existing.issue: Real and correctly located — ITC Kohenur, a Luxury Collection Hotel, in HITEC City overlooking Durgam Cheruvu. It is a full luxury property, not strictly 'value', but it is verifiable; recommend repositioning copy to acknowledge it as a luxury-tier HITEC City pick rather than a budget option.

replacement.name: ITC Kohenur, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Hyderabad
replacement.tagline: A 274-room ITC flagship in HITEC City overlooking Durgam Cheruvu lake, GRIHA 5-star and LEED Platinum — the pick for travellers basing in the modern western city and the IT corridor rather than the old town.
replacement.address: Plot No. 5, Survey No. 83/1, Hyderabad Knowledge City, Madhapur, HITEC City, Hyderabad, Telangana 500081

existing.name: Lumbini Garden Lakeside Resort
existing.issue: Lumbini Park is a public lakeside park on Hussain Sagar — it is a park with a boat jetty, not a hotel or resort. No 'Lumbini Garden Lakeside Resort' exists as bookable accommodation. Re-anchor the location slot to a verified central hotel near the Hussain Sagar / Banjara Hills core.

replacement.name: Park Hyatt Hyderabad
replacement.tagline: A calm, design-led 209-room hotel on Road No. 2, Banjara Hills — central, near KBR National Park and the Necklace Road lakefront, with walkable restaurants and shopping. The most location-convenient luxury base in the city.
replacement.address: Road No. 2, Banjara Hills, Hyderabad, Telangana 500034

existing.name: The Machan – Hyderabad
existing.issue: CROSS-STATE FABRICATION — The Machan is a treehouse resort in Lonavala / Paud, Pune district, Maharashtra. There is no Machan property in Hyderabad. Re-anchor the xfactor slot to a verified distinctive Hyderabad stay.

replacement.name: Taramati Baradari Resort (TGTDC)
replacement.tagline: A Telangana Tourism heritage resort built around the Taramati Baradari pavilion near Golconda Fort — a distinctive Qutb Shahi-era setting and an in-city alternative to the Maharashtra-based Machan that was wrongly tagged here.
replacement.address: Taramati Baradari, Ibrahim Bagh, near Golconda Fort, Hyderabad, Telangana 500091

existing.name: Sri Venu Gopal Temple Viharas (Temple Guesthouse)
existing.issue: MISNAMED — Kolanupaka's heritage site is the 2,000-year-old Kulpakji Svetambara Jain temple (Sri Rishabhanatha / Neminatha / Mahavira), not a 'Sri Venu Gopal' temple. The verifiable temple accommodation is the Kulpakji Shwetambar Jain Mandir Dharamshala. Re-anchor here.

replacement.name: Kulpakji Shwetambar Jain Mandir Dharamshala
replacement.tagline: The temple-run dharamshala at the 2,000-year-old Kulpakji Jain temple — two-bed AC/non-AC rooms and dormitory accommodation about 400 m from the Kolanupaka bus stand, with a food facility. Note: rooms are reserved for Jain pilgrims.
replacement.address: Kulpakji Jain Temple, Kolanupaka, Aler mandal, Yadadri Bhuvanagiri district, Telangana 508101

existing.name: Kolanupaka Eco-Stay (local homestay)
existing.issue: No verifiable 'Kolanupaka Eco-Stay' or registered homestay in Kolanupaka village — generic placeholder. Kolanupaka is a small Jain-temple village with no hotel-grade or verified homestay infrastructure of its own. Honest scarcity for the value slot.

existing.name: Hyderabad Deccan Chargers Guest House (Tandur, 25 km)
existing.issue: FABRICATION — 'Deccan Chargers' was a defunct IPL cricket franchise; there is no 'Deccan Chargers Guest House', and Tandur is a town in a different district roughly 100+ km away, not 25 km from Kolanupaka. Pure ghost with a wrong-distance cross-dest label. Re-anchor the location slot to budget hotels in Aler town, the nearest railhead.

replacement.name: Budget hotels at Aler town
replacement.tagline: Aler is the nearest railhead and town to Kolanupaka (about 6 km away) and holds the practical budget hotels for the area — the realistic location base, since the village itself offers only the Jain dharamshala.
replacement.address: Aler town, Yadadri Bhuvanagiri district, Telangana 508101

existing.name: Farmstay near Kolanupaka Village
existing.issue: Generic placeholder — no verifiable, named, bookable farmstay near Kolanupaka. The village is a thin-tourism Jain-temple stop most travellers visit as a day trip from Hyderabad or Warangal. Honest scarcity for the xfactor slot.

existing.name: Laknavaram Lake Resort
existing.issue: Refers to the TGTDC Haritha lake resort at Laknavaram — real, but the name should be tightened to the official 'Haritha Lake View Resort Laknavaram'.

replacement.name: Haritha Lake View Resort Laknavaram (TGTDC)
replacement.tagline: The only accommodation on Laknavaram Lake — the Telangana Tourism Haritha resort, with AC/non-AC rooms and cottages overlooking the water and the iconic island suspension bridge. Boat rides leave from the resort jetty.
replacement.address: Laknavaram Lake, Govindaraopet mandal, Mulugu district, Telangana 506345

existing.name: Laknavaram Village Homestay (local operators)
existing.issue: Generic placeholder — no verifiable, named homestay at Laknavaram. The lake sits in dense forest in Mulugu district with no village hotel or registered homestay infrastructure; the Haritha resort is the only on-site stay. Honest scarcity for the value slot.

existing.name: Feriado Resorts Tadvai
existing.issue: Real and verifiable — a 30-room forest resort in Tadvai, Mulugu district, run by Feriado Resorts. It is about 20 km from Laknavaram Lake, so it is a near-area base rather than lakefront; tighten copy to make the distance honest.

replacement.name: Feriado Resort Tadvai
replacement.tagline: A 30-room forest resort in Tadvai, about 20 km from Laknavaram Lake — the closest private resort to the lake and a comfortable base for the Mulugu lake-and-forest circuit including Eturnagaram sanctuary.
replacement.address: Tadvai village, S.S. Tadvai mandal, Mulugu district, Telangana 506344

existing.name: Cormorant Island Camping (seasonal)
existing.issue: Laknavaram has small forested islands reached by the suspension bridge and by boat, but there is no verifiable, named, bookable island camping operator ('Cormorant Island Camping' is not a real product). Any camping is informal/seasonal. Honest scarcity for the xfactor slot.

existing.name: Haritha Heritage Hotel Medak Fort (TSTDC)
existing.issue: Real and correctly located — the TGTDC Haritha Heritage Hotel built against the walls of Medak Fort. Tighten copy and brand reference (TGTDC) only.

replacement.name: Haritha Heritage Hotel Medak Fort (TGTDC)
replacement.tagline: The Telangana Tourism Haritha hotel built right against the walls of Medak Fort — well-kept suites and open-air dining under the heritage backdrop, the practical base for Medak Cathedral and the fort.
replacement.address: Medak Fort, Medak town, Medak district, Telangana 502110

existing.name: Vanam Resort, Masaipet
existing.issue: A resort at Masaipet (in Medak district, on the Hyderabad-Medak road) is plausible, but 'Vanam Resort' could not be pinned to a unique verifiable listing. Recast the value slot to a confirmed budget option in Medak town.

replacement.name: Sri Geetabavan, Medak
replacement.tagline: A clean, well-kept budget hotel in Medak town with tasty food at reasonable rates — the dependable value pick for travellers visiting Medak Cathedral and the fort who prefer a town base to the Haritha hotel.
replacement.address: Medak town, Medak district, Telangana 502110

existing.name: Haritha Hotel Edupayala (TSTDC)
existing.issue: FABRICATION — there is no TGTDC Haritha hotel at Edupayala. Edupayala (the Vana Durga temple at the meeting of three streams) is a festival pilgrimage spot in Medak district with no Haritha property; it does not appear in the official Haritha hotel list. Pure ghost. The Haritha Heritage Hotel Medak Fort is the verified state property; no separate honest location pick exists.

existing.name: Nagarjuna Resort
existing.issue: Generic name with no unique verifiable listing — 'Nagarjuna Resort' could not be confirmed on any booking platform or official site. Re-anchor to the verified Haritha Vijay Vihar Hotel at Nagarjunasagar, the established state-tourism property by the dam and island jetty.

replacement.name: Haritha Vijay Vihar Hotel, Nagarjunasagar (TGTDC)
replacement.tagline: The Telangana Tourism Haritha hotel at Nagarjunasagar — AC suite, deluxe and standard rooms with a pool, beside the dam. The closest practical base for the boat to Nagarjunakonda island and its Buddhist archaeological museum.
replacement.address: Vijayapuri South, Nagarjunasagar, Nalgonda district, Telangana 508202

existing.name: Vijaya Guest House
existing.issue: No verifiable 'Vijaya Guest House' at Nagarjunasagar / Nagarjunakonda on any platform — generic ghost. The verifiable value-grade accommodation in the area is the standard-room category of the Haritha Vijay Vihar Hotel; re-anchor there.

replacement.name: Haritha Vijay Vihar Hotel, Nagarjunasagar (TGTDC) — Standard rooms
replacement.tagline: The AC standard-room category at the TGTDC Haritha Vijay Vihar Hotel — the same dam-side setting at the lowest verified rate, the realistic value base since Nagarjunasagar has few credible private budget hotels.
replacement.address: Vijayapuri South, Nagarjunasagar, Nalgonda district, Telangana 508202

existing.name: Krishna Island Resort (Jetty-adjacent)
existing.issue: FABRICATION — Nagarjunakonda island holds the relocated archaeological remains and museum and has no accommodation; there is no 'Krishna Island Resort'. The island is a day-visit by boat only. No verifiable location pick on or beside the jetty beyond the Haritha hotel already covering the area.

existing.name: Nagarjuna Ashram Stay Experience
existing.issue: No verifiable ashram offering bookable visitor stays at Nagarjunakonda / Nagarjunasagar — the name conflates the Buddhist scholar Nagarjuna's historical association with a non-existent stay product. Honest scarcity for the xfactor slot.

existing.name: The Grand Sindhu
existing.issue: Hotel Grand Sindhu is a real 3-star hotel in Mahbubnagar, the nearest town to the Pillalamarri banyan tree (about 5 km away). Verifiable across booking platforms; tighten the name only.

replacement.name: Hotel Grand Sindhu, Mahbubnagar
replacement.tagline: A 3-star hotel in Mahbubnagar town — the most comfortable verified base for visiting the 800-year-old Pillalamarri banyan tree about 5 km away, since the tree park itself has only an exhibition centre and mini-zoo, no accommodation.
replacement.address: Mahbubnagar town, Mahbubnagar district, Telangana 509001

existing.name: Geetha Hotel
existing.issue: Mahbubnagar town has verifiable budget hotels and guesthouses. 'Geetha Hotel' is plausible as one of them but could not be confirmed to a unique listing; recast the value slot to a confirmed budget option in Mahbubnagar.

replacement.name: FabHotel Mint Park, Mahbubnagar
replacement.tagline: A verified budget hotel in Mahbubnagar town (FabHotel-branded, near NMIMS College) — a dependable, low-cost base for the short hop out to the Pillalamarri banyan tree.
replacement.address: Mahbubnagar town, Mahbubnagar district, Telangana 509001

existing.name: Avanthi Hotel
existing.issue: Mahbubnagar town has a set of mid-range and budget hotels close to the bus station and the Pillalamarri road. 'Avanthi Hotel' is plausible but could not be pinned to a unique verifiable listing; recast the location slot to the Mahbubnagar town hotel cluster nearest the tree.

replacement.name: Mahbubnagar town hotels (near Pillalamarri road)
replacement.tagline: Mahbubnagar's town hotels sit only about 5 km from the Pillalamarri banyan tree and 104 km from Hyderabad — the most location-convenient base, since the banyan park has no on-site stay.
replacement.address: Mahbubnagar town, near Pillalamarri road, Mahbubnagar district, Telangana 509001

existing.name: Banyan Tree Farm Stay (local operator)
existing.issue: Generic placeholder — no verifiable, named farmstay or distinctive property at or near the Pillalamarri banyan tree. The site is a tree park with an exhibition centre and mini-zoo, visited on a day trip. Honest scarcity for the xfactor slot.

existing.name: Park Hyatt Hyderabad
existing.issue: CROSS-DEST — Park Hyatt Hyderabad is a Banjara Hills luxury hotel in Hyderabad city, roughly 50 km from Pochampally. It is not a Pochampally stay; tagging a Hyderabad hotel as the village's experience pick is a mislocation. Re-anchor to the verified TGTDC Pochampally Haritha Hotel in the weaving village itself.

replacement.name: Pochampally Haritha Hotel (TGTDC)
replacement.tagline: The Telangana Tourism Haritha hotel in Bhoodan Pochampally — a small 6-room property with AC/non-AC deluxe rooms and a restaurant, the only hotel-grade stay inside the double-ikat weaving village, walking distance from weavers' workshops.
replacement.address: Bhoodan Pochampally, Yadadri Bhuvanagiri district, Telangana 508284

existing.name: Pochampally Heritage Homestay
existing.issue: No verifiable, named, registered homestay called 'Pochampally Heritage Homestay'. Weaver-family homestays are being developed under rural tourism schemes but are not yet a consistently bookable, verifiable product. Honest scarcity for the value slot until a registered homestay can be confirmed.

existing.name: Hotel Arjun Palace, Pochampally
existing.issue: No 'Hotel Arjun Palace' verifiable in Pochampally on any booking platform or official listing — ghost property. Pochampally village has only the small Haritha hotel (already used for the experience slot); no separate verifiable location pick exists in the village. Honest scarcity.

existing.name: Trident Hyderabad
existing.issue: CROSS-DEST — Trident Hyderabad is a luxury hotel in HITEC City, Hyderabad, roughly 50 km from Pochampally. It is not a Pochampally stay. For an xfactor pick genuinely tied to the village, the distinctive option is the weaving experience itself; re-anchor to the rural-tourism weaver homestay programme as the village's authentic xfactor, flagged as developing.
